_comment: verify-kani-mutation manifest — the Kani-side analogue of the Lean verify-proof-mutation gate (anti-vacuity for the firmware bounded-verification harnesses). For each entry, mutate a decoder/gate function in a way a specific Kani harness MUST catch, run ONLY that harness, and assert it flips to `VERIFICATION:- FAILED`. A green-when-it-should-be-red = a vacuous / under-constrained harness (the exact failure class the per-slice manual mutation checks caught by hand; this makes them a standing gate — work-todo §34/§35). Paths are relative to the repo root. Every entry uses `expect: kani_fails` (the load-bearing mutation must be caught); the `canary` doubles as the machinery-health check (if it survives, ALL results are void).

mutations.note: verify_rollback always-accepts -> the rollback_boundary biconditional (is_ok() <=> version > floor) MUST break. If this SURVIVES, the harness machinery is broken (kani not running / output not parsed) and every result is void.
the real anti-rollback off-by-one: `>=` would let a version==floor reinstall slip past the OTP rollback floor.
the execute(...) head->tail ABI offset byte; a wrong value = calldata the on-chain wallet mis-decodes into a different call.
perturb the multiSend record-walk cursor advance -> the exact-tiling partition proof MUST break (a hidden byte would ride between records).
excluding Blind from the value-page rule would silently drop a Blind record's non-zero native value -> the no-hidden-value WYSIWYS proof MUST break.
shift a GPv2Order field read by one byte -> the verbatim-offset decode-soundness biconditional MUST break.
